title: Glaze trial disposition sheet
passage:
Linden Ceramics | Glaze trial disposition sheet
Purpose: Select pieces for the customer’s colour viewing, not for a strength test.
Tray J: Even colour across the glazed face. There is a narrow unglazed band on the underside, where the test holder covered it. These pieces may be shown for colour. Put them on the viewing shelf.
Tray K: The finish is smooth, but one end is visibly darker than the other. Do not show these pieces as colour examples. Keep one on the comparison shelf to demonstrate the variation to the next shift.
Tray L: Tiny bubbles appeared after firing. Place these pieces in the reject bin after taking one close-up of the surface. Do not grind the bubbles away for viewing.
A piece stored on either shelf must keep its tray tag. Put the photo, not a reject piece, in the handover folder.

Linden 陶瓷｜釉色試作處置單
用途：挑選供客戶看色的樣品，不是做強度試驗。
J 盤：上釉面顏色均勻。底面有一條未上釉的窄帶，是試驗固定座遮住的位置。這些樣品可以供客戶看色，請放到看色層架。
K 盤：表面平滑，但一端明顯比另一端深。不要把這些樣品當作顏色範例給客戶看；在比對層架留一件，向下一班呈現色差。
L 盤：燒製後出現小氣泡。先拍一張表面特寫，再把樣品放進不良品箱。不要把氣泡磨掉後拿去看色。
放在任一層架的樣品都要保留原盤標籤。交接資料夾放照片，不放不良品實物。
